# Adaptify

> Adaptify LLC builds fast, SEO- and AI-search-optimized websites only for roofing companies. Static sites on Cloudflare with free hosting for life, delivered in the client's own Cloudflare and GitHub accounts.

## Offer
- Launch: $1,000 one-time. Custom 5-page site, local SEO and AI-search setup, free hosting for life, SSL and security. Live in 7 days or it's free. Includes free domain setup, a Google Business Profile audit and a launch-week review-request system. Optional: +$90/month for 5 small edits.
- Growth: $1,000 setup plus a required $600/month growth plan. Adds 6 SEO blog posts a month, AI search optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, unlimited small edits (48-hour turnaround) and a monthly performance report.
- Lead automation add-on: instant text-back, lead routing and old-quote follow-up, available on any plan. Pricing on request.
- Preview first, pay later: no payment until the homepage preview is approved. Clients keep their site, domain and content.
